Determine the normal from the penetration: compare overlapX and overlapY. Standard approach: ```js function ballBlockCollide(b) { const closestX = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x+b.w); const closestY = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y+b.h); const dx = ball.x - closestX, dy = ball.y - closestY; if (dx*dx+dy*dy > ball.r*ball.r) return false; // resolve const overlapX = (b.w/2 + ball.r) - Math.abs(ball.x - (b.x+b.w/2)); const overlapY = (b.h/2 + ball.r) - Math.abs(ball.y - (b.y+b.h/2)); if (overlapX < overlapY) { ball.dx = -ball.dx; ball.x += Math.sign(ball.x-(b.x+b.w/2))*overlapX; } else { ball.dy = -ball.dy; ball.y += Math.sign(ball.y-(b.y+b.h/2))*overlapY; } return true; } ``` Substeps: move the ball in small steps to avoid tunneling. speed ~340-460 px/s, dt ~1/60 → ~6-8px per frame, ball r 8, block h 20 → fine. But cap dt. Paddle collision: if ball is moving downward and intersects the paddle rect: reflect with angle: ```js const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x+paddle.w/2)) / (paddle.w/2); // -1..1 const angle = hit * (Math.PI/3); // max 60° const speed = Math.hypot(ball.dx, ball.dy); ball.dx = Math.sin(angle)*speed; ball.dy = -Math.cos(angle)*speed; ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5; ``` Also clamp the minimum vertical component to avoid near-horizontal trajectories: if |dy| < 0.2*speed, adjust.
